flux.proof: For smooth periodic native 6D scalars theta, Dtheta is a global 1-form; dDtheta=K F, so Stokes gives K m=0 on the closed internal curve.
flux.scope: fixed-modulus scalar, no defects or zeros; necessary topological condition only, not a vacuum or holonomy check
flux.hybrid_candidate: one native 6D zero-form along k2-k1; second 4D axion would need another origin, e.g. reduction of a tensor; no such tensor sector derived

Higgs_representation.scope: elementary dimensional reduction of the stated product-group gauge fields; no claim excluding added charged scalars, composites, or a separately derived unified group

potential.positive_bulk: no finite radial stationary point for any real sigma
potential.negative_bulk_beta_nonzero: stationary point exists iff r=alpha/beta>3; unique in (log rho,sigma)
potential.amplitude_relations: A=(r-3)B/2, C=rB; A=a*rho^-4, B=b exp(alpha sigma)rho^-6, C=c exp(beta sigma)rho^-2
potential.special_cases: beta=0,alpha!=0: no scalar stationary point; alpha=beta=0: scalar remains flat
potential.scope: two-field stationary minimum with positive scalar kinetic metric; conditional AdS when other equations satisfied; no parent-derived exponent or coefficient
